items.title: Jimmy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Ken Kimery is identified in the transcript notes as the 'recording engineer' and interacts only as a technical assistant/interrupter during the recording process.

ctx.x: Interviewer: Molly Murphy with recording engineer Ken Kimery Description: Transcript, 26 pp.
Molly Murphy: It is January 9th, 2010. I’m Molly Murphy and we are sitting here with Jimmy Heath, Professor Heath. Just to document this Jimmy, your birthday is October Jimmy Heath: That is correct.
